mpirun (Open MPI) 4.1.6

Report bugs to http://www.open-mpi.org/community/help/

limitations: This is a runtime/affinity preflight and does not prove CFD numerical accuracy.
The MPI probe is a lightweight Python launch; it does not replace production-size CFD scaling, scheduler allocation testing, or overnight stability.
Absence of scheduler environment variables means this evidence was collected from an interactive shell rather than a managed batch allocation.

recommended_policy.evidence: Preserve this manifest next to campaign summaries for production handoff.
recommended_policy.mpi: Use scheduler-native launch when available; otherwise record mpirun/mpiexec command and rank count.
recommended_policy.openmp: Set OMP_NUM_THREADS explicitly. For hybrid runs, set OMP_PROC_BIND=spread and OMP_PLACES=cores unless the site scheduler provides a stronger binding policy.
